# Part B - Availability calculation (generated by scripts/availability.py)

## 1. Redundant subsystems (2 independent replicas)

| Subsystem | Configuration | Calculation | Availability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Auth | 2 replicas | 1 - (1 - 0.995)^2 = 1 - 0.005^2 = 1 - 0.000025 | **99.9975%** |
| Course | 2 replicas | 1 - (1 - 0.995)^2 = 1 - 0.005^2 = 1 - 0.000025 | **99.9975%** |
| Registration | 2 replicas | 1 - (1 - 0.995)^2 = 1 - 0.005^2 = 1 - 0.000025 | **99.9975%** |
| Database | 2 nodes | 1 - (1 - 0.997)^2 = 1 - 0.003^2 = 1 - 0.000009 | **99.9991%** |
| Load Balancer | 1 instance (no redundancy) | given | 99.9500% |
| API Gateway | 1 instance (no redundancy) | given | 99.9000% |
| **End-to-end** | Series LB -> GW -> Auth -> Course -> Registration -> DB | 0.999500 x 0.999000 x 0.999975 x 0.999975 x 0.999975 x 0.999991 | **99.8417%** |

## 2. Does the design meet 99.9%?

- End-to-end availability = **99.8417%** (expected downtime 13.9 h/year, 68.4 min/month).
- Target 99.9% allows 8.76 h/year, 43.2 min/month.
- Result: **DOES NOT MEET** the target (short by 0.0583 percentage points).

## 3. Bottleneck (unavailability contribution of each subsystem)

| Subsystem | Availability | Unavailability | Share of total downtime |
|---|---|---|---|
| API Gateway | 99.9000% | 0.1000% | 63.1% |
| Load Balancer | 99.9500% | 0.0500% | 31.6% |
| Auth | 99.9975% | 0.0025% | 1.6% |
| Course | 99.9975% | 0.0025% | 1.6% |
| Registration | 99.9975% | 0.0025% | 1.6% |
| Database | 99.9991% | 0.0009% | 0.6% |

The API Gateway is a single instance at 99.90%: on its own it already uses the whole
99.9% budget, so any other component in series pushes the system below target.
LB + Gateway together cause ~94% of the expected downtime.

## 4. What-if: which redundancy change has the largest effect?

| Change | End-to-end | Downtime h/year | Meets 99.9%? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline (as given) | 99.8417% | 13.87 | no |
| +1 Auth / Course / Registration replica (3 each) | 99.8491% | 13.22 | no |
| +1 Database node (3 nodes) | 99.8426% | 13.79 | no |
| 2 Load Balancers | 99.8916% | 9.50 | no |
| **2 API Gateways** | 99.9415% | 5.12 | yes |
| 2 Load Balancers + 2 API Gateways | 99.9915% | 0.75 | yes |

Adding a second API Gateway replica has the largest single effect (about 13.9 -> 5.1 h/year of downtime) and is enough to meet 99.9%. Adding replicas to the already-redundant services barely changes the result.
